redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production conformance only.
Public official pages or documents retained as validation receipts; visibility does not imply bulk extraction or public-serving rights.
Exact GAR address information published as open/common-access data with source, release, download URL, transformations, schema, validity and digest pinned.
Credentialed, restricted, failed-download or unclear-rights material used only as specifically permitted and never promoted by assumption.
Personal, ownership, shipment, protected-property or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: The live page advertises 61,358 DBF records formed 2026-08-25 and official post-office index, hierarchy and name data. The current archive returned HTTP 417 to this audit and the relative numbered archive returned 404; no DBF row, complete address assignment or geometry was acquired.

The operator says an index is the unique post-office number to which an address is assigned and instructs users to enter an address on the office map. A public lookup receipt or map point is not a national assignment denominator or area.

Pinned API PDF for version 3.20. The postoffice response table advertises index, parent, name, type, region/locality and operational fields but no coordinates, Polygon or MultiPolygon. Dictionary access is not address membership or postal geometry.

GAR/FIAS is the official open/common-access address register. FNS describes current address information as available through the portal, twice-weekly snapshots and APIs. An exact current snapshot, its postcode attributes, history, exceptions, public fields, schema and digest require review; address authority does not supply a postal perimeter.

Federal Law 443-FZ establishes GAR address information as common-access information published including as open data and required for postal services. It is a legal basis for address data access, not a geometry artifact, postcode service-boundary definition or blanket right over Russian Post data.

artifact_partitions.rule: Operator office/index records retain exact release, six-digit text, source purpose, capture time, schema and digest; office infrastructure never creates a perimeter.
Address lookup and tariff/dictionary responses retain query purpose, access basis, freshness and digest and never imply bulk extraction, membership or geometry rights.
FIAS/GAR address identity, postcode attribute, lifecycle, public fields, open-data basis, release, schema and digest remain separately auditable.
Only exact source areas or reproducible complete-membership derivations may be published, with official/derived class, gaps, conflicts, exclusions, rights, topology, uncertainty and lineage.
Address, building, parcel, cadastral object and explicit address-building relation remain distinct; protected fields never enter public artifacts.
Administrative geometry, source coverage, postal coverage and sovereignty policy remain separate and never infer one another.
Recipients, residents, owners, contacts, credentials, shipments and protected property records never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic test evidence only; never promotion evidence.
